name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) is the hard goal the task requires. Precedence(door_open, key_lost) hard matches "until the door has been opened once", which the rules say is always Precedence even when the banned event already mentions a closed door. Both clauses trace to the task, and no clause is redundant or added.

texts: Pick up the target box in the other room (the mission's designated box).
Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once: key_lost may not happen before door_open has happened.
machine:

(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u3
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
